<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1398
Claimant:
Ryan Nelson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
01/12/2023
First notice of loss received for a side impact collision at an intersection involving the insured vehicle. The claimant
reports being the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side and is not represented by an attorney.
02/21/2023
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy, with coverage
in force at the time of the loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
03/02/2023
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the initial report, including the signal phase
and direction of travel. The account has not changed across contacts.
03/18/2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene and records the same sequence
of events. Two independent witnesses were interviewed and their statements mtach the other driver's account and
the scene photos.
04/22/2023
Inspected the vehicle and reviewed the photos. The damage is concentrated along the driver's side door and quarter
panel and is largely consistent with the angle and force described. No proir damage to the vehicle is known from
records or the claimant.
06/21/2023
The claimant reported a wrist fracture from bracing during impact. The injury is consisetnt with the kind and force of a
side impact of this type, and no prior injury to the same area is known from the claimant's history or medical records
requested so far.
07/05/2023
Medical records show treatment followed a typical course, including immobilization, follow-up imaging, and physical
therapy. Treatment frequency has tapered as the claimant's condition improved, in line with expected recovery.
08/20/2023
Confirmed with the claimant's treating provider that the treatment plan and visit pattern are standard for this injury. No
indication of unrelated or delayed care was found in the records reviewed.
09/07/2023
Reviewed all information gathered to date. Witnesses, photos, the police report, and the other driver's statement
support the reported sequence of events, and the injury and vehicle damage align with the described collision. File to
continue with standard handling pending final medical updates.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
